title: RenameDIMtoTORCH_DIM
bug_description:
### 🚀 The feature, motivation and pitch

`torch` defines `DIM` as a preprocessor directive which is also defined by other libraries, e.g. GROMACS (xref: https://gitlab.com/gromacs/gromacs/-/issues/5490)

Ideally every library should set `${NAME}_DIM` instead to prevent clashes. This would make integration much easier.
